description:
FIRST EXECUTION: apply the debloat method to MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md (1299 lines) section by section, using the composition + enforcement layers as the safety net that justifies the cut.

Section map already drafted this session (19 sections tagged keep-core / ->reference / consolidate-dupe / cite-provenance). Highlights: 5/10/11/12/14 -> reference; 7.3 -> delete-dupe (point to op-disc 12); 4/16/17/18/19 -> keep rule, cite provenance; 1/2/3/6/8/9 -> keep (tighten).

This is gauntlet work -> route through PLINY: DAEDALUS designs the slim structure + the module split + the reference/provenance destinations; ARGUS cold-audits for LOST CANON (the load-bearing risk - every empirical anchor must relocate to a bw cite, never be dropped); ADA executes; VERA/CATO/ZENO verify. LOSSLESS-ON-CANON is the acceptance bar.

After POLYBIUS proves the method, repeat for operating-disciplines.md (2110 - worst offender), MAJOR_PLINY.md (801), CAPTAIN_DAEDALUS.md (633).

DEPENDS ON: method + composition layer + enforcement layer being specified first (the cut is only safe once the layers that replace memorized-instruction exist).

Ledger-completeness walk DONE: every source section maps to a ledger row or KEEP-TIGHTEN — no DROPPED canon found in the cut. Subproject probe CONFIRMED against real ariadne deploy (self-contained 64KB role file, no modules dir at either tier). Web-check confirms #56686 current (~2wk ago) + new corroborators #29423/#29610 — recompose strategy 2b is sound. Found: (1) ledger arithmetic typo (5 SPLIT claimed, 4 actual); (2) §4.5 F1 'lean 2-sentence' deviates from 0hl 'mirror verbatim'; (3) recompose stub-marker format under-specified = the real LOST-CANON-at-subproject risk. Finalizing verdict + quadrant + 4 residuals.

PASS-WITH-RISKS: cut is LOSSLESS-ON-CANON (all 87 source headers map to a home; no dropped canon found; 6/9 C-1 cites spot-checked recover via bw show; subproject probe confirmed vs real ariadne deploy + current web). 2 load-bearing risks, both BUILD-SPEC not redesign: r1 install.sh recompose stub-marker format under-specified (the LOST-CANON-at-subproject vector); r2 SPLIT live-vs-provenance ref split under-specified per-line. 4 SHOULD-FIX + 2 CONSIDER total. Residuals: (1) KEEP s13 CONCUR; (2) C-2 to dedicated child tickets NOT comments; (3) PRESERVE numbers CONCUR; (4) RECOMPOSE over fork CONCUR w/ r1 hardening. Verdict saved: agents/verdicts/stoa--xyb.6/ARGUS-2026-05-23T07-09-08Z.md. Returning.

DAEDALUS (rev2 cold-pickup) activated on stoa--xyb.6. Read rev1 design + ARGUS PASS-WITH-RISKS verdict end-to-end. Producing design-rev2 incorporating r1 (recompose stub-marker spec) + r2 (per-line SPLIT enum) + r3 (ledger arithmetic) + r4 (lean-0hl deviation) + residual-2 (C-2 -> dedicated child tickets). Grounding live SPLIT line ranges + install.sh deploy path + modules/README.md recompose contract next.

Grounding complete. SPLIT live ranges confirmed: 16.7 (1034-1050) / 17.6 (1157-1164) / 18.6 (1217-1225) / 19.7 (1284-1295) = 4 subsections (confirms r3: 4 SPLIT not 5). install.sh MAJOR deploy = sed-substitution at L757-765 (recompose hooks here, subproject-only post-step). bw create supports --parent + -d (residual-2 child-ticket mechanism confirmed). Writing design-rev2.md to ABSOLUTE worktree path now (per process-hazard note: Write resolves relative against MAIN root).

pass: design-rev2 committed 4fa6c57 on arc-45/build (agents/design/arc-45/design-rev2.md, 517 lines). r1 RESOLVED: paired-sentinel marker <!-- MODULE-INLINE:<name> --> + awk state-machine + 4 FAIL-LOUD checks + P10/P10-neg probes (§2.7/§6.5). r2 RESOLVED: per-line SPLIT enum §3.8 (29 LIVE kept inline / 5 PROVENANCE clusters fold to 4 Anchors; incl §19.7 L1295 intra-line split). r3 RESOLVED: 4 SPLIT / 15 PROVENANCE (9 C-1 + 2 C-2 + 4 SPLIT), self-consistent. r4 RESOLVED: lean-0hl deviation stated explicit §2.4. residual-2 RESOLVED: C-2 -> dedicated child tickets xyb.6.1/.6.2 via bw create --parent -d. CONCUR held (§13 KEEP / PRESERVE-stubs / recompose-not-fork). §6.8 within-design marker-literal alignment verified. Author audit clean. Returning to PLINY.

ARGUS re-activated on stoa--xyb.6 (Arc 45 FOCUSED rev2 re-confirm). Reading design-rev2 (4fa6c57) + my rev1 PASS-WITH-RISKS verdict. Scope: r1 recompose robustness (LOST-CANON-at-subproject), r2 SPLIT classification spot-check, r3 ledger arithmetic, residual-2 child-ticket gate, adjudicate residual-3 Check-D scoping. NOT re-walking the whole cut.

rev2 audit pass: r2 SPLIT spot-checks CONFIRMED vs live source (§16.7 sources-cluster 1037-1040 = correctly PROVENANCE; §19.7 L1295 intra-line split correct: stoa--86k->Anchor, §17.5/§18.5 LIVE kept; §17.4 disambiguation parenthetical correctly kept verbatim). r3 arithmetic CONFIRMED (4 SPLIT live / 9 C-1 + 2 C-2 + 4 SPLIT = 15). Source has ZERO literal MODULE-INLINE strings; modules/README.md does NOT doc the marker convention (the brief's self-collision worry does not materialize). err() exits non-zero. Now reasoning the awk state-machine edge cases for r1 + adjudicating residual-3 Check-D scoping.

PASS-WITH-RISKS (rev2 re-confirm): r1-r4 + residual-2 all CLEARED. r1 recompose audited hardest across 6 edge cases (literal-sentinel bodies / regex anchoring / sed interaction / FAIL-LOUD coverage / idempotency / P10 canon-equivalence) - NO vector drops a body THIS arc (source has 0 MODULE-INLINE literals; full-line ^...$ anchoring resists prose false-triggers; 4 err()-checks abort vs ship partial). r2 both flagged calls CORRECT. r3 self-consistent. residual-2 child-ticket gate sound. 2 NEW non-blocking: F-B [SHOULD-FIX] §6.5 Check-D bullet reads global-glob (false-positives on marker-less PLINY) while §7.4 has the correct per-file form - make §6.5 match §7.4; F-A [CONSIDER] unstated module-body-no-close-marker constraint for the forward PLINY-cut recompose reuse. residual-3 RECOMMEND: scope recompose to $DEST_POLYBIUS ONLY this arc (min blast radius on riskiest surface) + defer both-files loop to gauntlet-gated PLINY cut. rev2 is ADA-BUILDABLE; neither new finding drops canon. Verdict saved: agents/verdicts/stoa--xyb.6/ARGUS-2026-05-23T07-23-13Z.md (sha256 round-trip OK). Returning.

ADA activated on stoa--xyb.6 (Arc 45 build). Read design-rev2 (4fa6c57) end-to-end + dispatch ticket heartbeat stream. Reading ARGUS re-confirm verdict + modules/README.md + op-disc §33/§12 + live MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md before any write. Worktree confirmed: arc-45/build at .claude/worktrees/arc-45-build. Will use ABSOLUTE worktree paths for every write.

Ground-check complete: read all 1299 lines of live MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md + install.sh deploy path + modules/README.md + op-disc §33/§12 + ARGUS re-confirm verdict. ALL ledger source line-ranges match live file exactly (no drift): §5 159-376, §10 538-634, §11 638-725, §12 729-803, §13 806-881, §14 885-895, §16.6 1022-1032, §16.7 1034-1050, §17.1 1096-1102, §17.5 1145-1155, §17.6 1157-1164, §18.5 1206-1215, §18.6 1217-1225, §19.6 1273-1282, §19.7 1284-1295. install.sh recompose insertion point = after L765 (post POLYBIUS+PLINY sed, pre op-disc deploy); err() exits 2; SRC_MODULES_DIR=SCRIPT_DIR/modules. Landing ARGUS F-B (per-file Check-D), residual-3 (DEST_POLYBIUS-only), F-A (close-marker guard as 5th check). Now running 9 C-1 bw content-check gate before any deletion.

C-1 content-check gate COMPLETE (9 cites): ezj/3cs/nax/32b.3/ads/k36/86k all RECOVER inline story richly. Drift flags (build to live, cites preserved verbatim): (1) ariadne--8fd is cross-project (not in stoa-- store; recovery from ariadne workspace) — keep in §15 Anchor as cross-project ref. (2) §16.6 cites stoa--p5g as 'Arc 25 cross-tier coordination' but p5g body is actually CREDENTIAL-discipline; 32b+dxw+32b.3 cover the §16.6 evidence; preserving all cited ids verbatim in Anchor (lossless). C-2 archive-first DONE: stoa--xyb.6.1 (§5.1.1.1) + stoa--xyb.6.2 (§5.1.3) created + content-checked (descriptions carry verbose prose verbatim). Now building 5 module files.

5 module files created + verified in worktree (not main): onboarding.md (218L, incl §5.6 lean 0hl fold + 2 C-2 cite-backs to xyb.6.1/.6.2), sub-project-spawning.md (102L), pair-programmer-authoring.md (93L), pair-programming-prototyping.md (79L), substrate-update-check.md (16L). P9 author-field check CLEAN (no author-like field in any module). F-A check CLEAN (zero MODULE-INLINE literals in module bodies — recompose idempotency safe). Now cutting the slim MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md: CONDITIONAL stubs+markers, PROVENANCE→Anchor, SPLIT per-line, DUPLICATE→pointer, KEEP-TIGHTEN, §3.5 routing-map+relocation-index, §4.5 0hl F1 lean.

Slim core first-pass landed: structural cut COMPLETE + correct (P3 stubs §5/10/11/12/14 preserved; 10 full-line MODULE-INLINE markers correctly paired; §3.5 prose mention of marker at L96 is in backticks mid-line, does NOT match ^...$ recompose regex — confirmed safe per ARGUS edge-case #2; P9 author-field clean). BUT P1 line-count = 653, over the >400 falsifier. Diagnosis: structural relocations done but KEEP-TIGHTEN rule-prose (§7=74, §16=72, §4=71, §13=69, §17=60, §19=58, §18=51) preserved near-verbatim instead of genuinely tightened. The design intends real prose tightening (§2.5/§3.6 'tighten verbose prose'), not verbatim-keep. Running a second tightening pass on the dense KEEP-TIGHTEN sections — preserving every load-bearing rule + cross-ref, compressing prose — to land in the 300-360 band.

Slim core cut verified LOSSLESS-ON-CANON: P2(10 paired markers) P3(5 stubs preserved) P4(§7.3→op-disc§12, verbose -m cookbook deleted) P9(no author-field) P11(all SPLIT LIVE pointers survive: §16.7 §4.5/§6/§7/§14/§15/§21/§30/handoff-author/§16.8; §17.6 §23/check.sh/apply.sh; §18.6 §6.7.1/PLINY§5.9; §19.7 §17.4/§29/agent-author/tier2-project-onboarding + §17.5/§18.5 intra-line LIVE half kept, stoa--86k folded to §19.6 Anchor) — ALL PASS. P1 line-count = 617 after two genuine tightening passes; over the 300-350 target. Diagnosis: markdown line count is dominated by preserved subsection-count + tables + blank-line separators (70 headings, 89 table rows, 91 bullets, 221 blanks), NOT prose length — and the ledger DELIBERATELY preserves every §X.Y for cross-ref stability (§2.7 CONCUR) + keeps §13/§16/§17/§18/§19 dense always-on rules inline (§3.6 KEEP-TIGHTEN, ARGUS weak-point#2). Prose-tightening lands within single physical md-lines so it barely moves line count. Will surface this as a ledger-vs-target tension + likely report verdict=partial on P1. Now writing install.sh recompose step (F-B per-file Check-D + residual-3 DEST_POLYBIUS-only + F-A 5th check).

install.sh recompose step COMPLETE + verified end-to-end (bash -n exit 0). P10 happy-path: subproject install recomposes DEST_POLYBIUS to 1125 lines (FULL band, all 5 module first-headings present, 10 paired markers kept as idempotency anchors); PLINY untouched at 801 lines, 0 markers (residual-3 confirmed). P10-negative: ALL 5 FAIL-LOUD checks fire with exit 2 + clean abort (no partial/slim file left): Check A (marker→no module), Check B (module→no marker, per-file), Check D (zero-markers+modules, per-file ARGUS F-B), Check E (close-marker-in-body, ARGUS F-A). Idempotency: re-run produces byte-identical 1125-line output. Fixed 2 bugs during verification: (1) awk exit triggered END double-fire → added _aborting guard (single diagnostic); (2) failed recompose left the slim sed-output on disk → now rm both tmp + slim role file on failure (design §6.5 'NEVER writes a partial/slim role file'). Now committing: (a) cut+modules+install.sh, (b) 0hl fold as separable slice.

partial (P1 only): BUILD COMPLETE, returning. 2 commits on arc-45/build: ee654d7 (cut + 5 modules + install.sh recompose) + 2074525 (lean 0hl fold, separable slice). Both carry Co-Authored-By: CAPTAIN_ADA_the-stoa; Author stays PRINCIPAL; no author-like field touched. Slim core MAJOR_POLYBIUS.md = 590 lines (was 1299; ~55% cut). PROBES: P2(10 markers) P3(5 stubs) P4(§7.3→§12, verbose cookbook deleted) P9(author clean) P10(subproject recompose→1098 lines FULL band, all 5 bodies + 0hl §5.6 inlined, 10 paired markers) P10-neg(all 5 FAIL-LOUD checks fire exit2 + remove partial file) P11(all SPLIT LIVE pointers survive, PROVENANCE folded to Anchors, §19.7 intra-line split correct) — ALL PASS. C-1 9 content-checks ran; C-2 xyb.6.1/.6.2 created+content-checked before deletion. bash -n exit 0. Idempotent. P1 ONLY shortfall: 590 vs 300-350 target (>400 falsifier) — KEEP-TIGHTEN §13/§16-19 dense always-on rules + every preserved §X.Y subsection + mandated §3.5 dual tables dominate physical line count; further cuts would drop load-bearing rules (violate LOSSLESS-ON-CANON, the hard bar) or relocate always-on core off-disk (design forbids). Matches ARGUS weak-point#2 prediction. LOSSLESS-ON-CANON at all tiers = MET. Verdict to PLINY: partial (honest scope on P1). VERA/CATO/ZENO next.
